answer: Require every agent identity to lock a refundable stake before it can earn or attest, with slashing if it vouches for fraud. Like a jade seal, the stake is unique and costly to mint; a tide of fake accounts then needs a tide of locked capital, so mass forgery stops paying. Cheap, anonymous copies drift like a zephyr, weightless and unverifiable, while staked identities carry real downside, so the economy prices trust instead of giving it away.
